steps.name: Given a COMPANY user "reconsent-company@lifecycle.test" with consents not accepted
And a session exists for "reconsent-company@lifecycle.test" as COMPANY
When the user sends POST to "/partnership-opportunity" with empty body
Then the response status should be 403

expected 403; response body: {"timestamp":"2026-11-02T09:01:24.049101407","status":403,"error":"Forbidden","message":"You must accept the updated terms to continue using the platform","path":"/api/partnership-opportunity","code":"error.auth.consent_required","requestId":"REQ-e9268ef8"}
And the response should have header "X-Consent-Required"
headers: vary, x-request-id, x-consent-required, x-content-type-options, x-xss-protection, cache-control, pragma, expires, x-frame-options, content-type, content-length, date, keep-alive, connection
When the user records consent for all required documents
And the user "reconsent-company@lifecycle.test" refreshes their mock session as COMPANY
Then the response status should be 200

expected 200; response body: {"id":2530,"firebaseUserId":"E2ECOMPANY1793610083985","userType":{"value":"COMPANY","label":"Firma","originalLabel":"COMPANY"},"email":"reconsent-company@lifecycle.test","profilePicture":null,"addresses":[],"accountStatus":{"value":"ACTIVE","label":"Aktywne","description":"Konto jest aktywne i w pełni funkcjonalne","originalLabel":"ACTIVE","colorTheme":"success","icon":"user-check","canLogin":true
